interpretation_limits: This completes mechanical evidence aggregation and sampled grounding review, not an independent second semantic grade for every criterion or an external human blind study.
Material support asks whether actually supplied evidence can support a necessary point, even if the answer omitted it. It is not answer accuracy or a replacement for frozen content scores.
Graph records may support a point when the content was actually supplied and provenance is verifiable. The full index is only an audit source; its unsent facts are not automatically model evidence.
A supplied Source/graph record can support a claim despite wrong extra fine line numbers, which remain location mismatches. Bare file/line citations are assessed at the referenced span.

Citation segmentation and answer styles differ. Fractions are descriptive over annotated existing groups, with missing citations separate; no ranking of industry accuracy or content/evidence composite is justified.
Six decoder failures remain outcomes with zero final-answer scores; normalized envelopes do not recover the unavailable raw SSE or prove the exact remote failure mechanism.
Unequal total context/calls, incremental cache reuse, overlapping cohorts and the small chosen question set retain the limits recorded in the content/execution reviews.
